approved.text: InDataFlow provides one operational control layer for cargo, documents, milestones and client visibility.
InDataFlow includes an internal operations dashboard.
InDataFlow includes a client dashboard for shipment visibility.
Documents can be uploaded and linked to cargo records.
The workflow supports document validation and verification states.
Cargo milestones can be tracked with timestamps.
InDataFlow maintains cargo activity and audit history.
Plans include a digital document archive.
InDataFlow uses volume pricing instead of per-seat pricing, with no long-term contract.
Qualified high-intent prospects can start a 14-day trial.

restricted.text: Real-time claims require technical confirmation for the specific feature.

Going live within a week requires operational evidence.
Paying-client and live-usage claims require current Founder approval.
Percentage reductions and measurable savings require source evidence and Founder approval.
